searchUrl.title: Search URL
searchUrl.description: ZipRecruiter search results URL. It is used when no searchQuery or location is supplied. Precedence: searchQuery, then location, then searchUrl.

searchQuery.title: Search Query / Keywords
searchQuery.description: Job title or keywords to search for. Takes precedence over location and searchUrl.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional location filter, such as New York, NY, California, or Remote. Takes precedence over searchUrl when searchQuery is empty.

maxJobs.title: Maximum Jobs
maxJobs.description: Maximum number of job listings to save. Use 0 to continue until the page limit or source results are exhausted.

maxPages.title: Maximum Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of result pages to request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy configuration. A US residential or unblocker proxy is recommended because ZipRecruiter may block datacenter traffic.
